authority.name: Global Biodiversity Information Facility
authority.publisher: GBIF Secretariat as API aggregator; no underlying occurrence publisher was represented because the retained statewide occurrence response was empty.

terms.license: GBIF occurrence data uses record-level Creative Commons licenses; the retained empty occurrence response contains no occurrence records.

geography.method: Require explicit GBIF stateProvince text matching Alaska and explicit GBIF county-equivalent text that resolves uniquely through the registered active county-equivalent registry to FIPS 02020, Anchorage Municipality, Alaska.
geography.coordinatePolicy: Coordinates are not used for county assignment; missing, ambiguous, retired, conflicting, or coordinate-only county-equivalent geography is rejected.

taxonomy.method: Use the strict GBIF species match endpoint and require EXACT match type, confidence at least 95, SPECIES rank, a numeric species key, and exact canonical binomial agreement; Rorippa austriaca matched GBIF speciesKey 3053406 with EXACT match type and confidence 99.

requests.purpose: Resolve the target to a strict exact GBIF species identity before occurrence acquisition.
Acquire the complete statewide Alaska preserved-specimen occurrence response for the exact matched taxon and screen the leased county-species pair by explicit county-equivalent text.

limitations: The registered source has no negative semantics; an empty query, source silence, or a rejected occurrence cannot support verified absence.
GBIF occurrence search does not provide target-specific survey method, effort, or an explicit negative result and therefore cannot support not-detected.
Only qualifying positive preserved-specimen occurrences can become determination evidence.

caveats: GBIF is an aggregator and publisher record quality can vary.
The retained statewide occurrence response contains zero records, so no occurrence publisher, record license, or source freshness field is available for this screen.
The live search has no fixed snapshot identifier; retained provider bytes, request URLs, timestamps, and hashes pin this screen.
The completed empty screen is researched unresolved only and does not support verified absence or not-detected.
